The problem

The Founder's Trap

If you're the only one who can qualify your leads, you don't own a scalable business. You own a very stressful job.

💬

100+ unread messages

Every Monday starts with damage control instead of strategy and decisions.

⏱

Slow response times

Leads go cold while you're in meetings, asleep, or doing actual work that matters.

📋

Manual data entry

Copying WhatsApp conversations into spreadsheets is not a growth strategy.

🔍

No lead visibility

You can't remember who said "ready to pay" in the flood of DMs and messages.

How it works

Your digital front office

Four steps. Zero manual work on your end.

01

Inquiry arrives

A prospect messages via WhatsApp, website, or any channel — at any hour, any day.

02

Agent qualifies

Your AI agent responds instantly, asks smart questions, extracts budget, timeline and intent.

03

Summary delivered

A clean, structured lead brief lands in your Telegram or email — only the gold leads.

04

You close

You step in only when a lead is qualified, serious, and ready to move forward.
